target.statement: Video-Zero (Iter 4) with Qwen3-VL-4B achieves 29.75 mIoU on ANet-RTL, compared with the base model's 16.86 mIoU.

compute.basis: The target requires reproducing multi-iteration GRPO self-evolution of a 4B video MLLM on video data, which is far beyond an 8-core CPU/16GB laptop and needs high-memory GPUs; the laptop cannot meaningfully run the protocol.

blockers: Requires training Qwen3-VL-4B with GRPO over multiple self-evolution iterations on video data, which needs high-memory GPUs.
CPU-only 8-core/16GB laptop cannot load or train a 4B video VLM at the scale needed for this result.
Exact 600-video sample, full training configs, and dependency details may not be fully packaged in the linked repo.
Evaluating the full protocol also requires downloading and preparing multiple video benchmarks.
title: Video-Zero: Self-Evolution Video Understanding
